description: This file defines utility template functions for parsing unsigned integers, signed integers, and byte counts from strings, including support for hexadecimal formats and suffixes. It provides a flexible and type-safe way to parse numeric values from string inputs, primarily used within the Android base library.

methods.name: bool ParseUint(const char * s,T * out,T max=std::numeric_limits<T>::max (),bool allow_suffixes=false)
methods.description: Template function to parse an unsigned integer (decimal or hexadecimal) from a C-string, with optional suffixes and maximum value constraint.

methods.name: ParseUint (overload)
methods.description: Template function to parse an unsigned integer from a std::string.

methods.name: bool ParseByteCount(const char * s,T * out,T max=std::numeric_limits<T>::max ())
methods.description: Template function specialized for parsing byte counts with suffixes allowed, from a C-string.

methods.name: ParseByteCount (overload)
methods.description: Template function to parse byte counts from a std::string.
